segments.source: The example below creates an [`NSWindow`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSWindow) and uses optional chaining to check that the window’s delegate exists before sending a message to the delegate.
segments.normalizedSource: The example below creates an [`NSWindow`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSWindow) and uses optional chaining to check that the window’s delegate exists before sending a message to the delegate.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let myWindow = NSWindow( contentRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 5120, height: 2880), styleMask: .fullScreen, backing: .buffered, defer: false ) myWindow.delegate = MyDelegate() if let fullScreenSize = myWindow.delegate?.window(myWindow, willUseFullScreenContentSize: mySize) { print(NSStringFromSize(fullScreenSize)) } ```
